The composition root signs and packages the feature-owned installer-canary manifest with the host application key; host instrumentation needs the feature data and domain test dependencies. App Zygote acquisition instrumentation consumes the SELinux domain from the installed host. The feature-owned exit-handler device fixture is assembled into the host instrumentation APK to exercise its actual native runtime with an ordinary app UID.
Exercises the signed canary against the actual installed application, whose application ID, signing key, asset and version are required for self-update semantics.
Opt-in integration coverage needs the actual installed host and its SDK App Zygote preload; assertions remain test-only and the generic detector smoke test stays independent.
